title: Simply Beautiful
description: Minecraft with a fresh perspective. Improved visuals and QOL features.
body:
![The open fields of Minecraft. A place to potentially start your own little project.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ad96aea27dd281608641c3cf83e508c03b9eb419_0.webp)

### About the Modpack
Simply Beautiful is my **personal** vision of a more **_immersive_**, refined version of Minecraft, one that focuses on _visual depth, atmosphere, and quality-of-life improvements_ without losing the simplicity and charm that define the game.

This modpack is built to offer a **_fresh_** perspective on Minecraft by enhancing how the world looks, feels, and plays on a _day-to-day_ basis without compromising the unique feel and nostalgia the game brings to some.

Thank you for supporting me and my modpack! Have a good rest of your day.
